problems: Cliopatria's Surakarta Sunanate and Sultan of Yogyakarta rows start in 1744, eleven years before the Giyanti partition (1755) and inside the Mataram interior; Cliopatria's Dutch Republic row covers most of the former Mataram coast from 1744. The dossiers for those states should start at 1745/1755 and the Dutch Republic dossier should be checked against the 1743 loss in mataram-sultanate.
Cliopatria's Sultanate of Malacca row overlaps Mataram's 1626 outline (173 of 235 cells in 1600): the known Malacca artefact, not touched here.

Sambas, Mempawah, Sukadana and Bima are given the end year of their independence from the pages (1819, 1831, 1833, 1905), not Cliopatria's (1821, 1827, 1833, 1889); the sultans reigned on under Dutch control to 1950, 1944, 1847+ and 1958, so the dutch-east-indies (se-03) and dutch-republic (eu-09) dossiers may want vassal tints for them. Bima was a 'subordinated ally of the VOC' from 8 December 1669.
Patani runs 1400-1786 against Cliopatria's 1572-1690 (the page keeps the kingdom to the 1786 Siamese conquest); Kelantan's departure is a confidence-1 bridge at 1691.
The Mataram page names Sukadana as a Mataram vassal from 1622; sultanate-of-sukadana, patani-kingdom and ayutthaya-kingdom each carry the matching or neighbouring events and should be read together.

Bima has one validator warning (the 1920 vassal_end lies after the 1905 end); patani-kingdom has one (the predecessor Langkasuka has no dossier). Kedu, Bagelen, Madura, Priangan and the Borneo and Sumbawa towns are not in the gazetteer; circles stand in, so nothing fails to resolve.
